title: Session gate: replace passcode proxy.ts/lib/gate.ts with Supabase-session check
goal: proxy.ts today checks a signed cookie with a fixed 'ok' payload (lib/gate.ts) and returns a bare-text 401 with no link back to any form -- the audit's P0 finding. This story replaces the whole mechanism, not just the payload, and fixes that dead end as a side effect of the replacement rather than a separate patch.
in_scope: proxy.ts: replace verifyGateCookie(...)-based check with a Supabase session check (via the SSR client reading the request's cookies) -- valid session passes through, no session redirects.
Unauthenticated navigation request -> NextResponse.redirect('/login?next=' + pathname), not a 401 body.
Unauthenticated API/data route request -> keep returning 401 (no redirect makes sense for a fetch/XHR caller).

Carry over the existing exemption list unchanged: UNGATED_PWA_ASSETS, /icons/, api/cron/* (proxy.ts:24-43) -- these exemptions were reasoned through carefully (S-35/REQ-27 comments) and none of that reasoning changes with the auth mechanism swap.
Delete app/gate/ (page.tsx, actions.ts), lib/gate.ts, and the GATE_COOKIE_SECRET env var -- not kept as a fallback path alongside the new mechanism.
out_of_scope: Any change to the PWA-asset/cron exemption logic itself -- only the thing being checked changes (session vs. signed cookie), not what's exempted.
app/(auth)/login and app/(auth)/signup pages themselves -- those are S-57/S-58, this story only wires the gate to redirect to them.
acceptance: A request to any gated route with no valid session redirects to /login?next=<original path> instead of returning a bare 401 page. A request to a gated API/data route with no valid session still returns 401. app/gate/, lib/gate.ts, GATE_COOKIE_SECRET are removed from the codebase.
invariants: The exemption matcher (static assets, api/cron/*) must remain functionally identical -- a regression here would either re-lock the PWA shell or gate cron routes that authenticate themselves independently.
next param must be validated as a same-origin relative path before being used in the redirect, to avoid an open-redirect via a crafted next value.
